messages:
Maya Chen: Quick design sync — thinking of replacing the generic 'Stop' affordance with a 'Pin draft' model so partial streaming output becomes a frozen draft message users can reference or edit. Feels more like writing workflow. Thoughts?
Devin Patel: 'Pin draft' reads well for writers. Two infra q's: keyboard bindings (Esc or P?) and regeneration semantics (create new draft vs replace pinned?).
Sasha Rivera: Prefer 'Pin draft' over 'Stop' — less panic. Microcopy: 'Pin draft', 'Unpin', 'Regenerate reply', 'Resume live'. For replace semantics, add an explicit 'Replace draft' action to avoid surprises.
Alan Ng: Token meter placement idea: instead of a per-message pill, experiment with a compact inline meter inside the composer top-right (small progress bar + numeric badge) and a collapsible per-message badge for exports. Keeps the message UI lighter.
Jyoti Rao: Accessibility: ensure the inline meter has a text fallback like 'Session tokens used: 1,234' and that the progress bar has role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, min, max. Avoid announcing token increments while streaming.
Devin Patel: Implementation note: session-level counter should be rate-limited updates (e.g., every 400ms) to avoid perf spikes and SR noise. For per-message badges, only update once message finalizes or when pinned.
Playground Bot: TokenWatch: session tokens so far 1,128 (+48 pending). Estimated cost $0.0056.
Maya Chen: I like session meter + per-message badge on demand. UX question: when a draft is pinned, do we auto-copy to conversation or treat as separate draft object? I'd prefer separate draft object that appears inline with an edit affordance.
Sasha Rivera: Draft as separate object seems clearer. Microcopy for edit affordance: 'Edit draft' and 'Apply draft' (applies content into composer). Also tooltip: 'Pin creates a read-only draft. Use Edit to modify.'
Alan Ng: For keyboard: map 'P' to pin/unpin when focus is in stream, Esc toggles live/resume. Ctrl+Enter remains send. We'll prototype with key map overlay.
Jyoti Rao: For SRs, when a draft is pinned announce once: 'Draft pinned' with role=status and aria-live=polite. If user edits draft, announce 'Draft updated'. Avoid making token updates audible unless user asks.
Devin Patel: Prompt library idea: inline quick-insert bar under composer with pinned prompts and a small history. Support drag-to-pin from the full library. Filter should be instant but debounced 150ms for large libraries.
Maya Chen: Microcopy suggestion for the quick-insert: 'Insert prompt' buttons should be small labels like 'Use'. Toast after insert: 'Prompt added to composer Undo'. Keep toast dismissible.
Sasha Rivera: Accessibility for toast: make it keyboard-focusable and include an Undo button that is reachable via tab. Toast should not steal focus from composer; announce via polite live region only.
Playground Bot: UXHints: when pinning long streaming replies, show small shimmer skeleton for pinned draft while it finalizes to make the action feel immediate.
Maya Chen: Action items: 1) Alan/Devin prototype inline session meter + per-message badge toggle 2) Devin + Alan prototype pin/unpin + keybindings + shimmer 3) Jyoti write SR acceptance (announce pinned/updated; no token spam) 4) Sasha finalize microcopy and toast behavior 5) Product ops evaluate export semantics for drafts/system chips.
Alan Ng: I'll start meter prototype and the shimmer for pinned drafts — aim EOD Tuesday.
Devin Patel: I'll wire the keyboard maps and debounce behavior on updates.
Jyoti Rao: I'll draft the accessibility checklist and short QA script.
Sasha Rivera: I'll update copy and tooltips and send a Figma slice.
Maya Chen: Thanks team  — I'll consolidate notes and post the spec. If no objections we'll run a small user test next week. :sparkles:
